On the last date i.e. 20.12.2024 also, none had appeared on behalf of the petitioner when the following order was passed:
"1. Case called out.
2. None is present on behalf of the petitioner.
3. This Court had passed the following order on 20.12.2024:-
"Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This petition seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite parties to conduct a free, fair, effective and speedy investigation in FIR dated 18.04.2024, bearing Case Crime No. 0096 of 2024, under Sections 406,420,409,506 I.P.C., P.S. Indira Nagar, District Lucknow.
The Investigating Officer concerned shall file his personal affidavit with regard to the active investigation made in this case within a period of four weeks.
List after four weeks.

"
4. Learned AGA prays for and is granted two weeks further time to file personal affidavit of the Investigating Officer, failing which the concerned Investigating Officer shall appear before this Court along with the case diary on the next date.

5. List on 06.11.2025."

4. In compliance of the aforesaid order, Investigating Officer, Chandra Prakash, SI, P.S. EOW,
Commissionerate Lucknow, filed his personal affidavit disclosing the current status of the investigation.

5. Learned AGA submit that notices have been issued to the Bank and after recording of the statements and perusal of the accounts, investigation shall be concluded expeditiously and the report shall be filed accordingly.
6.
Since none is present to press the petition, it is dismissed for non prosecution.
7. However, this order will not come in the way of the investigation which shall be concluded expeditiously, as stated by learned AGA.
